meta.description: Live apps in the GBAutomation portfolio. Each entry corresponds to a runnable repository under gbauto/app-* on GitHub.

apps.name: Logo Motion
apps.tagline: Brand-aware logo animation via gpt-image-2 + FFmpeg motion interpolation
apps.description: Capability concept for reading a logo PNG and a brand sidecar, generating keyframes through OpenAI image editing, then interpolating motion with FFmpeg. Public run metrics are withheld until a source-backed receipt is attached.

apps.name: Claude HTML Artifacts
apps.tagline: Self-contained HTML mini-apps generated by Claude playground sessions
apps.description: A curated catalog of standalone HTML artifacts produced by Claude during playground / approved-path sessions. Each artifact is a single index.html with no backend, sandboxed for safe rendering inline. Publishing is gated to the Claude playground plugin and explicitly approved automation paths.

apps.name: Client Portal Validation
apps.tagline: Internal tenant route validating the reusable client portal and repository sync pattern
apps.description: A private GBAutomation portal that proves the /clients/<slug> route shell, existing auth wrapper, TAC validation receipt, and tenant sync runbook before external client repos are connected.

apps.name: Jason Diaz Portal
apps.tagline: Private PMC/Archon workspace hosted under the reusable client portal route
apps.description: A gated client route for Jason Diaz that embeds the synced Archon web bundle and long-lived HTML artifacts under /clients/jid5274.

apps.name: YouTube Intel
apps.tagline: Channel allowlist, transcript coverage, and artifact reporting for the TAC-backed YouTube pipeline
apps.description: A private GBAutomation operations app for managing YouTube channel intelligence, indexing transcript artifacts, and tracking reports from the YouTube Intel pipeline.
